recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three women with identical bouffant hairstyles and red dresses, arranged in a staggered horizontal line against a warm, cream-colored studio backdrop. The composition features heavy typographic blocks in the upper right quadrant, utilizing bold slab-serif fonts and decorative horizontal dividers.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects creating a rhythmic repetition
High-contrast red garments against a neutral, warm-toned background
Top-heavy typographic balance opposing the bottom-weighted subjects
Uniformity in styling (hair, makeup, clothing) emphasizing group identity

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the bottom two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central woman's face, positioned slightly lower than the flanking two.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the bold title text top-right, moves down to the central figure, then sweeps left and right to the other two women.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open area in the top left and center-top to accommodate text and branding.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, black, and cream

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed display faces
letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast in the display title
Uniform cap height for the primary name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif paired with a heavy slab-serif for impact.
graphicDevices: Horizontal decorative rule composed of repeating small glyphs or patterns

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic of the era
Captures the high-contrast serif look for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three women with 1960s red-tinted bouffant hair, wearing identical sleeveless red cocktail dresses, posing against a warm cream-colored textured wall. The lighting is soft and even, typical of mid-century studio portraits.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a right-aligned block of text in the upper right. Use a bold slab-serif for the main name and a high-contrast serif for the title above it. Include a thin decorative horizontal line between the two text elements.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm cream color?
Are the dresses a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the typography right-aligned and heavy?
Do the hairstyles reflect the early 1960s aesthetic?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no overlapping of text and faces
Check that the red color doesn't bleed into the skin tones
Verify the slab-serif font is sufficiently heavy
Confirm the background texture looks like aged cardstock
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait of [Subject Trio] + [Era-specific styling] + [Right-aligned Slab Serif Typography] + [Warm Tri-color Palette]
